decision.summary: Within allowed context [570,729], a transient multi-axis shift begins at index 608 (U drop dominant), but no full return is observed. A later rebound in U (~660–662) lacks coordinated cross-axis recovery and does not restore prior levels; both intervals remain uncertain due to ambiguous or absent return phases.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply (~10 MAD) at index 608, with smaller correlated N down (~2 MAD) and E up (~2 MAD); interior (609–611) shows sustained offset without recovery; return not observed within allowed context.
U rebounds sharply near 660–662, while N/E show small opposing offsets (N up, E down) — inconsistent with a coherent return; no reversion to pre-608 baseline observed by 729.
